scope: CLASS141 source-authentic dynamic-only ordinary property table non-clone observations: foreach, array cast independence, by-reference promotion, and empty-history rematerialization.

cases.source:
<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class TableObserve141 {}
$source = new TableObserve141;
$source->alpha = 7;
$source->beta = 9;
echo "before:";
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
unset($key, $value);
$array = (array) $source;
$array["alpha"] = 11;
$source->beta = 13;
echo "after:", $source->alpha, "/", $source->beta, "/", $array["alpha"], "/", $array["beta"], "|";
foreach ($source as $key => &$value) { if ($key === "beta") $value = 17; }
unset($key, $value);
echo "ref:", $source->alpha, "/", $source->beta, "/", $array["beta"], "|Z|";

<?php
#[AllowDynamicProperties]
class HistoryObserve141 {}
$source = new HistoryObserve141;
$source->alpha = 7;
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "first:", $key, "=", $value, "|"; }
unset($key, $value);
unset($source->alpha);
echo "empty:";
foreach ($source as $key => $value) { echo "bad|"; }
$source->beta = 9;
echo "later:";
foreach ($source as $key => &$value) { echo $key, "=", $value, "|"; $value = 19; }
unset($key, $value);
$array = (array) $source;
echo "final:", $source->beta, "/", $array["beta"], "|Z|";
